title: A shared home beyond ready comfort

captions.physics: Choosing routines with attention to both

meaning: Your home becomes more whole when familiar comfort has its place without governing every other possibility in your shared life.
text: You can arrange home through mutual choice: discussing needs, considering taste and deciding together what fills your space. The Lovers in the physical position of Muladhara describe participation in action. The Devil in energy tests your footing through attachment to compulsory comfort, without which life seems insufficiently good. The World in emotions seeks wholeness, with different needs given their places. Yet feeling settled is hard when one habit quietly occupies too much time and space while the rest of shared life continually adapts around it.

For example, home viewing requires a certain chair, lighting, food and unchanging time. Everything is arranged, but other activities together fit only into accidental gaps. **A whole home contains more than one familiar way of being together.** This does not make the favourite ritual bad. It can keep its meaning without an exclusive right to govern the evening. Ready comfort becomes part of shared arrangements instead of the condition governing whether you may feel good at home at all.

The difficulty is experiencing any limit on the ritual as destruction of established comfort. Protecting completeness makes you service the sole familiar form more precisely, narrowing life further. Wholeness grows through agreement that notices both the pleasure’s value and which other shared wishes currently lack room beside it. Your home can then hold a wider range of the life you want.
